name: Dakota
summary: Circle Line stop by Old Airport Road / Dakota Crescent edges — food density, stadium adjacency, and condo/HDB mix with shorter CBD hops than far-east towns.
body: Dakota is the east-central shortlist when Circle Line access and Old Airport Road food matter more than a quiet cul-de-sac. Housing mixes newer condos, older estates, and proximity to stadium / indoor sports gravity toward Kallang. Expats land here for CCL hops and lifestyle density; accept event traffic and tourist-food weekends as the tax. Compare with Guillemard for a slightly broader residential road belt, Eunos for calmer EWL heartland living, and Mountbatten / Stadium catchments when you want to be even closer to sports infrastructure.
bestFor: CCL workers who want Old Airport Road on the doorstep
renters trading quiet for food and sport access
car-light couples testing east-central before RV prices
watchOuts: Condo MCST quality varies — read by-laws
housingMix: Condo inserts with older estate edges; food and sports infrastructure nearby.
commuteNotes: Circle Line at Dakota; test an event evening and a rainy walk to Old Airport Road.
